description.value: Bowen eBikes is an eBike rental and full-service maintenance shop located steps from the Snug Cove ferry terminal, making it the natural first stop for cyclists arriving from Horseshoe Bay on a day trip or island stay. As the island's sole bike repair facility, it stocks a broad range of parts and handles everything from tubeless flat repairs and spoke replacements to full drivetrain tuneups. The shop also offers the island's only Low Speed Vehicle rental — a 40 km/h golf cart — for groups or riders who need an accessible alternative.
